summary: China Yuchai International filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated October 20, 2026, announcing that its wholly owned subsidiary Guangxi Yuchai Foundry and Guangxi Zhenye New Materials established Guangxi Aobei Technology Company Ltd., an ADI heat-treatment joint venture in Yulin, Guangxi. Registered capital totals RMB 50 million: Yuchai Foundry contributes RMB 17 million for 34%, Zhenye contributes RMB 33 million for 66%. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, or premium is stated. This is a routine commercial joint-venture formation, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
